import sys, json, re
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
protected = ['spendly.db', '.env', 'migrations/']
dangerous_pattern = r'\b(rm|unlink|truncate)\b\s+.*'
if re.search(dangerous_pattern, cmd):
    for p in protected:
        if p in cmd:
            print(f'BLOCKED: Cannot run destructive command on protected file: {p}', file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(2)

import sys, json, re
data = json.load(sys.stdin)
cmd = data.get('tool_input', {}).get('command', '')
protected = ['spendly.db', '.env', 'migrations/']
dangerous_pattern = r'\b(Remove-Item|rm|del|ri|erase)\b\s+.*'
if re.search(dangerous_pattern, cmd, re.IGNORECASE):
    for p in protected:
        if p in cmd:
            print(f'BLOCKED: Cannot run destructive command on protected file: {p}', file=sys.stderr)
            sys.exit(2)
